column1: # skill visual -> effect launch table. Source: Interlude client animations/skill.usk
# full dump with original enum names: Docs/interlude-whitelist/skill-visual-effects.tsv.
# skill_id: SkillVisualEffect object name = visual id that Interlude skillgrp.dat references in its
#   visual column (skill.<group>.<id>); skills with an empty visual column resolve by their own id.
# phase: CastingAction / ShotAction / ExplosionAction / ChannelingAction (Interlude *Actions arrays).
# attach_on: Interlude EAttachMethod mapped to the generator enum:
#   EAM_None->0, EAM_RH->2, EAM_LH->3, EAM_BoneSpecified->7, EAM_AliasSpecified->8, EAM_Trail->9;
#   empty = property not set in the object (engine default).
# scale: Interlude has no per-action scale (only bSizeScale), so the column is always empty.
